title: ticfac Phase 4: Cloudflare as a compatibility host
description: SPEC §12 Phase 4. Move cloud/factory/** to ticfac/cloudflare/** preserving routes initially; RunWorkflow hosts the reconciler (one Workflow per EpicRun) with tracker access through the contract-held TypeScript implementation (§3.1); repository Durable Object as one-slot lock and serialized publisher; cloud/sandbox/** to ticfac/image/**; cloud/worker/** stays in ticks; run/attempt/decision records move from D1 into .ticfac/ on the run branch pushed on origin at once, D1 as rebuildable index or removed; move Factory credentials, embedding, deployment bundles and CI.

acceptance_criteria:
An epic runs to completion unattended and stops at a PR that is REVIEWED and CI-VERIFIED, for a person to merge.

Reviewed: the final review ran as a dispatched job, not as a claim - its verdict and every finding it raised are on the PR where the person merging reads them, and any finding still awaiting triage is named rather than silently carried.

CI-verified: CI is green on the head that would be merged, re-derived from the forge at the moment the close-out completes rather than trusted from earlier - and if the run's own writes moved the head, the close-out says which commit the verdict is about (9da).

Unattended: waves, per-tick gates, the final review and the close-out all complete with no operator intervention. Count the interventions and report the number; one is a failure of this gate. Merging is NOT an intervention - it is the one step this gate deliberately leaves to a person.

Also: a Workflow restarted mid-run resumes from .ticfac/ and reconciles every in-flight attempt, and the TypeScript tracker client passes the pinned 3.2 fixtures.
